title: Retrieval-evaluation corpus manifest
description: Validates manifest.yaml (parsed to JSON) at a frozen fixture corpus root (Phase A, docs/roadmap.md "Phase A — Retrieval evaluation baseline"). Declares the migrations that build the corpus, the k values the harness reports Recall@k and MRR for, and the expected census of the built result. Whether `migrations` order agrees with each file's own ULID ordering, and whether `census` agrees with a real build, are the loader's to verify (S2) — this schema states the shape of the manifest alone.

contractVersion.description: Version of this manifest contract. Bumped when a required key is added or removed; the corpus content has its own versioning through `corpusId`.

corpusId.description: Stable slug identifying this fixture corpus, e.g. `adr-corpus-v1`.

kValues.description: The k values Recall@k is reported for, e.g. `[1, 5, 10]`. Bounded to 50, the same bound `knowledge.search`'s wire contract clamps `limit` to (`MAX_RESULTS`, packages/theurian-core/src/theurian/mcp/tools.py) — a k beyond it could never be reached by a real response.

migrations.description: The migration files that build this corpus.

census.description: Expected item and chunk counts for the two indexes every disclosure-equality query runs against: `full` (built from every migration, including `withheld`-plane ones) and `clean` (built from `visible`-plane migrations only).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this corpus fixture covers.

file.description: Migration filename: a 26-character Crockford base32 ULID followed by a slug, matching this project's migration file naming.

plane.description: Whether this migration's content belongs to both corpora (`visible`) or to `full` only (`withheld`, the synthetic secret rows a disclosure-equality query must never surface from `clean`).

items.description: Total knowledge items expected in this corpus.

byStatus.description: Expected item count per status; a status with zero expected items is simply absent rather than listed as `0`.

bySensitivity.description: Expected item count per sensitivity label; a label with zero expected items is simply absent.

chunks.description: Total indexed chunks expected in this corpus.
